_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (18% break rate) plus no funding flush or ETF reversal means the honest call is hold inside/near the Complacency band until a breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicitly HOLD to Complacency; narrative supplies no forward phase but crowded-long warning is compatible with CAUTION/HOLD rather than a directional long
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 42-54, 30d momentum remains drift, ETF flows stay near flat, and long-short crowding cools without a liquidation cascade
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks below 39 with funding negative, or ETF flows reverse hard and F&G pushes above 55, or Solana long-short flushes violently from the 97th percentile
